1.title: ‘Love Me’ Artist Demands Trump Stop Using Song
1.summary: President Trump used JMSN’s song in a recent self-promotional video that was paid for with public money.

2.title: Clancy Returns to Court as Lawyers Seek Investigation of Holdout Juror
2.summary: Lawyers representing Lindsay Clancy have also asked a judge to find her not guilty, saying insufficient evidence was presented at her murder trial, which ended in a mistrial this month.

3.title: Jack Smith, Former Special Counsel, Will Appear Before Congress
3.summary: Mr. Smith’s testimony will be the latest public clash over the use of prosecutorial power in American politics.

4.title: Evicted Spanish pensioner can move back home, lawyer says
4.summary: The eviction of Maricarmen Abascal, 87, prompted large-scale protests across Spain.

5.title: Evicted Woman Set to Return Home as Spain Plans Fixes to Housing Crisis
5.summary: The eviction of an 87-year-old set off protests in the country, which has an acute housing shortage. The government said it would present laws to protect renters.

6.title: Rubio Says Incident at UK Air Base RAF Fairford ‘Clearly Involved’ a Foreign Actor
6.summary: The U.S. secretary of state, Marco Rubio, told Fox News that what happened at a base used by U.S. bombers flying to Iran was “very serious,” without providing details.
